{{DISPLAYTITLE:NHC_PERIOD}}
{{TAGDEF|NHC_PERIOD|[real]|40}}

Description: Time scale of the [[Nosé-Hoover chain thermostat|Nosé-Hoover chain]] in terms of the number of MD steps. 

----

{{TAG|NHC_PERIOD}} sets the time scale (<math>\tau</math>) of the [[Nosé-Hoover chain thermostat]]. It is expressed in terms of the number of MD steps and must be interpreted in combination with the time step set by {{TAG|POTIM}}. The setting {{TAG|NHC_PERIOD}}=0 corresponds will generate the NVE ensemble. 
{{NB|tip|The value of {{TAG|NHC_PERIOD}} should correspond to a characteristic time scale in the system. If this is unknown, {{TAG|NHC_PERIOD}} should be set to a value between 20 and 200.}}
